meta.title: Follow-on /create screens reskins: S3/S4 and S8 onward labels, buttons, selects, notices, errors, help, nav and dialogs -> DCC display text (display only)
meta.version_file: tables/create-screens-reskins.version.json (sha256, built_at, entry_count, diff, companions); history in tables/create-screens-reskins.CHANGELOG.md

id_scheme.id: Stable kebab-case id per UI string. Prefix says the kind: method-, ability-, stat-, title-, button-, select-, modal-, field-, package-, choice-, opt-, nav-, dialog-, notice-, error-, hint-, help-. Never change once published.
id_scheme.chargen_ref: Where the 5e name comes from in tables/chargen-5e.json, when it does.
id_scheme.lookup: Look up by id. Fall back to the old text (also stored) when an id is missing.

meta.display_rule: Label rows (state=label): new == combined_label == 'Our Name (5e Name)' (+ a suffix such as ': pick {n}'), exactly one pair of parentheses in the combined label, unique combined labels. Text rows (state=text): new replaces old; same {placeholders}, same numbers, rules facts unchanged. Display only: ids, values, numbers, skill/tool/spell names and the logged-dice wording are untouched.

delivery.a: This file: labels and texts keyed by id. The bridge hard-codes these strings today (see code_ref), so each row needs a one-time code hook: replace the literal with a lookup by id (the same pattern as lineageLabel/featLabel; gate with a setting like create.background_reskin until Caleb approves).
delivery.b: tables/create-flow-lines.proposed.json: the vanilla create-flow-lines keys rewritten with the same keys, placeholders and variant counts. Deliver through the bridge's merge layer (mergeProposedLines in screenstext.js, behind the flag). Copying it over create-flow-lines.json would fail test/roll.test.js:249 and :308 (they assert the old S8_roll_closed and S8_roll_keep_ok text; per Syndicate audit F6). Keys already and near_dup have no consumer in the bridge today.

plain_views.rule: Rows with screen ALL carry plain_on. On those views (S1, S2, the comfort-only view, the S13 survey) show the old text, not the new one. No S2 or survey-specific rows are rewritten.

needs_code_items: every row: the bridge hard-codes the literal today (see code_ref); hook by id, with old as the drift-guard text
meta.source_match: found = the old text was located in src/create at build time (code_ref). not_found = the old text is a paraphrase of a dynamic string; the Architect should confirm the exact literal.
meta.tone: DCC System voice (see create-flow-lines.json): dry, clear, snark aimed at the job, the choices and the gear, never the person. Adults-only table, cursing cleared. Crawlers, never the other word.
consumers: /create S3, S4, S6 choices, S8 to S17 and the shared nav/dialogs

vanilla_on_purpose.why: Same rule as skills. The S10 'pick type' items stay as the real item types.
